FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Aircon in Durban

Everything you need to know before getting your air conditioner installed or repaired in KwaZulu-Natal.

How much does aircon installation cost in Durban?
The cost depends on unit size, brand, installation complexity and pipe run length. South Breeze provides free, no-obligation quotes. Call 061 789 7060 or email sales@southbreezecooling.co.za.
Which aircon brands does South Breeze install?
We supply and install Daikin, Samsung, LG, Midea, Gree, Carrier and Hitachi across Durban and KZN. We'll recommend the best brand and size for your budget.
How often should I service my air conditioner in KwaZulu-Natal?
At least once a year — ideally every 6 months for frequently used units in KZN's warm, humid climate. Regular servicing prevents breakdowns and keeps warranties valid.
Do you offer emergency aircon repairs in Durban?
Yes. South Breeze offers 24/7 emergency call-outs across Durban and greater KZN. Call 061 789 7060 or WhatsApp us for fast response.
What size air conditioner do I need for my room?
Approximately 600W (0.6kW) per m². A 15m² bedroom typically needs a 2.5kW (9,000 BTU) unit; a 30m² space may need 5kW (18,000 BTU) or more. Contact us for a free assessment.
Does South Breeze service areas outside Durban?
Yes. We serve Umhlanga, Pinetown, Westville, Hillcrest, Ballito, Amanzimtoti, La Lucia, Berea, Morningside and the greater KwaZulu-Natal region. Contact us to confirm availability in your area.
